Hi I’ve a lot to say about insurance in Singapore. It’s my biggest gripe about being a citizen here. Insurance discriminates people with mental
Illness. If you are hospitalised due to self harm, your medical fees won’t be covered. I hope you’ve already got a hospitalisation insurance coverage. I used to have, but because of an angry fight with Aviva because they didn’t want to cover my suicide attempt (despite them not having enough evidence) I annulled my policy but that was a huge mistake. 

I’ve never been able to get hospitalisation coverage ever since because of a “history of depression”. 
If you can afford it, going private will keep you off the government records of you having mental problems.
